- package_name: `sendsidebwe`

## Summary
Implements the send-side bandwidth estimator used by the SFU. The package tracks TWCC send and feedback data, groups packets into queuing measurements, evaluates loss and delay signals, manages probe clusters, and reports congestion state changes with an estimated available channel capacity.

## Responsibilities
- Implement the `bwe.BWE` send-side estimator.
- Track sent packets and consume transport-wide congestion control feedback.
- Group acknowledged and lost packets into delay and loss measurements.
- Detect early-warning and congested states from queuing delay, weighted loss, and captured traffic ratio trends.
- Manage probe cluster lifecycle and probe-based capacity updates.
